description: This header defines the HashStore class, which is a specialized implementation of the Store interface for distributed key-value storage with extended API features like multi-get and queue operations.

classes.name: HashStore
classes.description: A distributed hash-based key-value store class supporting extended operations like multi-get, multi-set, queue operations, and key checks within the c10d distributed namespace.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the HashStore instance.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value for a given key.

methods.name: compareSet
methods.description: Compares the current value with the expected value and sets it to the desired value if they match.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key.

methods.name: void wait(const std::vector<std::string> & keys)
methods.description: Waits for the specified keys to satisfy certain conditions or timeout.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Atomically adds a value to an existing key's integer value.

methods.name: getNumKeys
methods.description: Returns the total number of keys stored.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks the existence or condition of multiple keys.

methods.name: deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specified key from the store.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends data to an existing key.

methods.name: multiGet
methods.description: Retrieves multiple values for a list of keys.

methods.name: hasExtendedApi
methods.description: Indicates support for extended API features like multiOperation.

methods.name: queuePush
methods.description: Pushes a value to a queue associated with a key.

methods.name: queuePop
methods.description: Pops a value from a queue associated with a key, optionally blocking until available.

methods.name: queueLen
methods.description: Returns the length of the queue for a key.
